Highlight Clip: CleanSpark CBO: Power Access Will Be Bitcoin Miners' Key Competitive Advantage CleanSpark CBO: Power Access Will Be Bitcoin Miners' Key Competitive Advantage CleanSpark CBO Harry Sudock told What Bitcoin Did on November 5 that if starting a company today, he'd build an energy business first, then decide whether its power would serve Bitcoin mining or AI. CleanSpark measures its business in megawatt-hours, megawatts, and acres, with AI data centers offering a way to realize their value. Bitcoin miners can adjust electricity consumption based on prices or contracts, while AI data centers manage grid balancing differently. Sudock sees transmission, not generation, as the main US power-grid bottleneck, requiring further investment in transmission and distribution alongside solar, natural gas, and nuclear power. — link
